_comment_budgets: Weighted-token budgets. These are the ONLY numbers that turn measured usage into a percentage, and Anthropic does not publish them, so they are estimates you calibrate once - see README.md.
_comment_anchor: Weekly window anchor in local time. weekday: 0=Sun .. 4=Thu .. 6=Sat. Defaults to Thu 21:00 to match the 'Resets Thu 9:00 PM' shown in Claude Code's own usage panel.
_comment_weights: Per-token weights, mirroring the usual relative cost of each token class.
_comment_models: Per-model multiplier applied on top of the token weights. Unlisted models fall back to defaultModelWeight.
_comment_buckets: Extra weekly bars broken out by model, like the 'Fable' row in the usage panel. Each bucket gets its own budget.
